## PI0286 owner erratum — correction bank 27/32; optimizer deadline partial

Evidence commit: `7f27d51f091b47fa3393b6e3df1a831f1a95e4dc`, existing branch `pi0267/executor-decoupled-recovery`. Authority remains #6072813602 / release `eae6dbc1f9281b204a4e28e5f7c100d705837318`.

**This explicitly supersedes the interpretation in #6073520074 that 15/32 was a protocol-valid scientific C1 data failure.** I added a zero-preclip diagnostic-count gate to the implementation; the released contract did not contain that independent gate. The original comment, code, hashes, raw observations and V1 reports are preserved.

### Actual corrected data result
| Takeover | Requested / faithful restores | Physical success | Original physical-codec pass |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 3s | 16 / 16 | 15 | 14 |
| 12s | 16 / 16 | 13 | 13 |
| Total | 32 / 32 | 28 | **27** |

Twelve previously rejected late windows have float64 intermediate normalized excess only, at most 9.60565e-11. The unchanged native processor still performs its original clipping; actual encoded FP32 labels are legal and byte-identical to directly casting the diagnostic intermediate to FP32. Their native physical roundtrips pass the original thresholds. No label, statistics, teacher, scorer or physics changes were made. The genuine 285118@3s SO3 failure (max 0.010654909 rad) and four physical failures remain excluded.

Only the added count==0 condition was removed. Boundary checks retain the original physical/nonfinite/degeneracy gates. Saved full-H40 maxima/errors produced separate `BANK_NATIVE_CONTRACT_V2.json`, **27/32**, SHA256 `f2c7b43af6edc42795ee0595ed0a9c9f05f440369945d5b43bfc38419e21cb8d`. No teacher/model/physics rerun.

### Sampler finding is separate
The implemented global-exact-equal-branch sampler was attempted once: forced hold-only draws >=1517 exceed fixed hold quota205. Its global-exact branch condition is stricter than an explicit reading of equality within behavior buckets. This is an implementation constraint failure, **not proof that the released within-bucket weighting or the correction data are scientifically infeasible**. No fallback sampler, changed quotas or second attempt was run.

### Actual training status and time boundary
655971 is still terminal F / Exit_status1, before model load, PBS walltime17s. Cross-mount identity check was repaired and CPU verified. **New formal updates0, discarded canary0, checkpoints0.** No explicit sequential replacement-lease authorization arrived before the protocol §6 11:30 not-yet-started-arm deadline. No replacement was submitted. C0/C1 therefore remain NOT_EXECUTED; no new TRAIN/DEV/CONFIRM_C quality result or learning benefit exists. Current stop is **DEADLINE_PARTIAL**, not a new model quality FAIL. CONFIRM_C remains unqueried.

The Hopper stop route now records the actual time gate; its old 15/32 route is preserved and superseded. Videos and fixed-revision evidence archival continue without new scientific calls.

### Storage completed
Exact retired failure payload deletion: Hopper allocated decrease122781892608 bytes (~114.35GiB); Corelab31440916480 bytes (~29.28GiB). Protected DOSE full14-file parent is still present; small failure evidence and HF history retained. Latest Hopper cached quota report (11:23) shows898.6GB/1.0TB; exact live quota headroom remains UNKNOWN. All48 closed raw episode slots were copied to durable Core NFS with complete member-hash readback, then only their SSD duplicates retired; this preserves evidence and is separate from failed-weight deletion.

[Full erratum and source-bound receipts](https://github.com/Leo-6-maker/go2-arx5-hierarchical-vla/blob/7f27d51f091b47fa3393b6e3df1a831f1a95e4dc/reports/PI0286/correction/IMPLEMENTATION_GATE_ERRATUM_NATIVE_CONTRACT_V2.md)

Old PI0285 confirmation20/32 FAIL remains unchanged. Source Panda/NON_REALTIME only; WBC/Go2/hardware0, selected/deployment=NONE.
